newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS Land says Raffles listing in 1998.
newsitem.headline: DBS Land says Raffles listing in 1998.

text.p: The listing of Raffles Holdings, a subsidiary of Singapore property giant DBS Land, will take place in the first half of 1998, the deputy chairman of DBS Land said.
"We expect to list this company in the first half of next year," Han Cheng Fong said at an investor briefing here.
He said the listing of Raffles, the hotel group of DBS Land, has been reset due to poor market conditions.
"The market is expected to be soft over the next eight months," he said. "We hope to take it to listing next year (in the) first half."
Raffles Holdings runs the Raffles hotel, the premier hotel in the city-state. It has also recently bought the Brown hotel in London and another hotel in Hamburg, Germany.
